cards.card_text: The temple is completed on the third day of the month of Adar.
cards.verse_text: And this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.
cards.snippet: …this temple was completed on the third day of the month of Adar, in the sixth year of the reign of King Darius.

cards.card_text: The month of Adar, most of a year away.
cards.verse_text: And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.
cards.snippet: And the lot fell on the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

cards.card_text: The order is to destroy, kill and annihilate all the Jews, young and old, women and children, and to plunder their possessions on the thirteenth day of Adar.
cards.verse_text: And the letters were sent by couriers to each of the royal provinces with the order to destroy, kill, and annihilate all the Jews—young and old, women and children—and to plunder their possessions on a single day, the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month.
cards.snippet: …to plunder their possessions on a single day, the thirteenth day of Adar, the twelfth month.

cards.card_text: The edict sets one single day across all of King Xerxes's provinces: the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar.
cards.verse_text: The single day appointed throughout all the provinces of King Xerxes was the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar.
cards.snippet: …Xerxes was the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar.

cards.card_text: Here it is, friend: the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, Adar.
cards.verse_text: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, the king’s command and edict were to be executed.
cards.snippet: On the thirteenth day of the twelfth month, the month of Adar, the king’s command and edict were to be executed.

cards.card_text: The enemies of the Jews had a plan for the thirteenth of Adar.

cards.card_text: Then on the fourteenth of Adar, the Jews in Susa come together again.
cards.verse_text: On the fourteenth day of the month of Adar, the Jews in Susa came together again and put to death three hundred men there, but they did not lay a hand on the plunder.

cards.card_text: The Jews in the provinces did all this on the thirteenth of Adar, and once again they left the plunder alone.
cards.verse_text: This was done on the thirteenth day of the month of Adar, and on the fourteenth day they rested, making it a day of feasting and joy.

cards.card_text: So that's why the Jews out in the villages keep the fourteenth of Adar as a day of joy and feasting.
cards.verse_text: This is why the rural Jews, who live in the villages, observe the fourteenth day of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting.
cards.snippet: …live in the villages, observe the fourteenth day of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting.

cards.card_text: The village Jews keep the fourteenth of Adar as a holiday.
cards.verse_text: This is why the rural Jews, who live in the villages, observe the fourteenth day of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting.
cards.snippet: …live in the villages, observe the fourteenth day of the month of Adar as a day of joy and feasting.

cards.card_text: Mordecai sets the celebration for the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar, the days the Jews gained rest from their enemies.
cards.verse_text: to establish among them an annual celebration on the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar as the days on which the Jews gained rest from their enemies and the month in which their sorrow turned to joy and their mourning into a holiday.
cards.snippet: …annual celebration on the fourteenth and fifteenth days of the month of Adar as the days on which the Jews gained rest from their enemies…
